proxyStages.label: Canonical availability
proxyStages.interpretation: The edition was published and verifiably reachable. This is operational readiness, not readership.

proxyStages.label: Discovery delivery
proxyStages.interpretation: An edition reached an approved discovery channel. Delivery is not engagement or return.

proxyStages.label: Platform engagement and return
proxyStages.interpretation: Provider-reported aggregate engagement or return. Keep each platform separate because one person may appear on more than one platform.

proxyStages.label: First-party return proxy
proxyStages.interpretation: A privacy-preserving site return measure, if David authorizes collection. It remains unknown while first-party return measurement is paused.

proxyStages.label: North star
proxyStages.interpretation: Distinct people who genuinely engaged on at least two days in the rolling seven-day window. This is the proof goal and remains unknown until an authorized aggregate method exists.

metrics.label: Dispatch-to-site latency
metrics.formula: Median of exact public-site verification timestamp minus actual dispatch timestamp for due editions; p95 and sample count are also reported.
sources: Spark trigger journal or GitHub workflow dispatch event
exact public URL verification in a GitHub run or redacted receipt
metrics.unknownBehavior: Unknown unless both actual timestamps exist for the exact edition. Never substitute a scheduled time, render time, commit time, or an older edition.

metrics.label: Dispatch-to-X latency
metrics.formula: Median of verified X publication timestamp minus actual dispatch timestamp for due editions; p95 and sample count are also reported.
sources: Spark trigger journal or GitHub workflow dispatch event
Spark X send receipt or repository X read-back receipt
metrics.unknownBehavior: Unknown unless actual dispatch and exact-edition X publication timestamps are both observed. A skipped or kill-switched lane is not success.

metrics.label: Edition success rate
metrics.formula: Due editions with a successful workflow, exact archive entry, HTTP 200 exact public URL, and verified exact title divided by due editions with observed outcomes.
sources: GitHub Actions run and exact public-page verification
metrics.unknownBehavior: Unknown when no due outcome is observed; partial when any due outcome or observation day is missing. Absence alone is not failure.

metrics.label: Telegram receipt success rate
metrics.formula: Exact-edition Telegram receipts with status sent divided by due editions with observed Telegram outcomes.
sources: redacted GitHub Actions Telegram receipt artifact
metrics.unknownBehavior: Unknown without an exact-edition redacted receipt; partial when coverage is incomplete. Missing is never zero or success.

metrics.label: Watchdog success rate
metrics.formula: Due editions whose watchdog observed exact_edition_present divided by due editions with observed watchdog outcomes.
sources: Spark watchdog journal or normalized watchdog receipt
metrics.unknownBehavior: Unknown without an exact-date, exact-slot watchdog result; partial when coverage is incomplete.

metrics.label: Genuinely engaged returning people
metrics.formula: Distinct people with a qualifying engagement on at least two separate days in the rolling seven-day window. Qualifying engagement must be declared before collection and must exclude passive page loads.
sources: provider-reported returning-person aggregates kept separate by platform
metrics.unknownBehavior: Unknown with reason not_authorized until David authorizes a first-party method. Never add platform counts because the same person may overlap.

metrics.label: First-party returning readers
metrics.formula: Privacy-preserving aggregate count of site readers observed on at least two separate days in the rolling seven-day window under an explicitly authorized method.
metrics.unknownBehavior: Unknown with reason not_authorized while first-party return measurement is paused. Do not use cookies, fingerprinting, IP addresses, local notes, or reader-submission data.

metrics.label: X followers
metrics.formula: Aggregate follower count displayed by X or manually entered from X analytics at the recorded timestamp.
metrics.unknownBehavior: Unknown when no dated source exists. A stale observed value must retain its original timestamp and be labeled last-known, not current.

metrics.label: X impressions
metrics.formula: Provider-reported aggregate X impressions for the declared rolling seven-day window.
metrics.unknownBehavior: Unknown unless a dated provider aggregate is manually entered. Missing analytics are not zero.

metrics.label: X link clicks
metrics.formula: Provider-reported aggregate link clicks on David's Daily Bread X posts for the rolling seven-day window.
metrics.unknownBehavior: Unknown unless a dated provider aggregate is manually entered. Do not infer clicks from impressions or public reaction counts.

metrics.label: YouTube subscribers
metrics.formula: Aggregate subscriber count reported by YouTube Studio at the recorded timestamp.
metrics.unknownBehavior: Unknown unless a dated provider aggregate is manually entered. Missing analytics are not zero.

metrics.label: YouTube returning viewers
metrics.formula: Provider-reported returning viewers for the declared seven-day window.
metrics.unknownBehavior: Unknown unless YouTube exposes the metric for the exact window and a dated aggregate is entered. Do not estimate from views.

metrics.label: RSS subscribers
metrics.formula: Aggregate subscriber count from an authorized RSS source, if one exists.
sources: manual aggregate from an authorized RSS platform
metrics.unknownBehavior: Unknown when the public feed exposes no subscriber count. Never estimate from feed availability or requests.
